caption: The drawing depicts a single pottery jug placed centrally against a plain, light-colored background. The jug has a wide, rounded body, a narrow neck, a slightly flared rim, and a curved handle extending from the rim to the shoulder. The jug is predominantly yellowish-brown, with visible areas of darker shading to indicate contours and shadows. The surface of the jug is decorated with various patterns and motifs in dark brown and reddish colors, including stylized flowers, leaves, and geometric shapes such as zigzags and spirals. Some of the decoration also features lighter highlights, possibly in white. The mouth of the jug appears uneven or chipped at the edge, revealing a subtly varied coloration along the rim. The background is unadorned, drawing attention to the intricate design and shape of the jug.
title: Pennsylvania German Puzzle Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
